method: Fresh scoped primary-page reading plus response receipts. Historical source-review dates, accepted locators and 10C2 receipts are unchanged. HTTP 200 is not a claim verdict.

questions.locator: T6, explanation: bracketed weekdays and named-day override
questions.independent_review: Parentheses apply to weekdays before Sundays/public holidays. Sunday, ordinary weekday and school-holiday alternatives are wrong; red times/named-day exceptions are preserved.
Passenger-car stem excludes the daylight-motorcycle exception. No is the sole correct choice; darkness, vehicle age and overtaking create no permission.

questions.locator: Trafikförordning 3 kap. 24,26,29,46 §§; 9 kap. 1–2 §§; Trafikverket 7 February 2025, Aktiviteter från vecka 7 final bullet
questions.independent_review: Conditional safe return route is sensible; sudden stop, forced conflict and reversing are unsafe. Road geometry, signs and access still govern; no automatic U-turn permission. Historical local example supports an editorial inference, not current routing advice. The old article is readable in this fresh browser observation, unlike the previous retrieval; historical receipts are preserved.

questions.classification: safety advice, foreign source limited to general application
questions.locator: DVA Taxi Manual v2.1 printed/PDF page 83, Tailgating; Trafikförordning 3 kap.16 §
questions.independent_review: Gradual forward-gap increase permits gentler braking. Punishment braking, smaller forward gap and speeding increase risk. Necessary emergency braking must not be delayed. No foreign law, numerical gap target or collision-prevention guarantee is imported.
Notify affected owner or police promptly and provide details. Small apparent damage, a month delay and photographing only own car do not discharge duties. Injury reporting is a separate condition.

questions.locator: Transportstyrelsen Vikter: Tjänstevikt bil; Totalvikt bil; Bruttovikt; Maximilast
questions.independent_review: Ready weight includes driver once; registered total adds maximum passengers/goods. Current scale reading is gross weight, luggage alone incomplete, speed-times-fuel irrelevant.

questions.locator: Transportstyrelsen Besiktning/Körförbud; Fordonsförordning 6 kap.15–17,21 §§; Ställa av/Köra ett avställt fordon
questions.independent_review: Missed periodic deadline causes automatic ban, distinct from off-road registration, no reminder extension or condition-based waiver. Booking does not permit ordinary driving. On/off-road journey exceptions and dangerous-condition bans differ; inspection performed ends original deadline ban without guaranteeing the result permits driving.

Own-car damage is outside own compulsory traffic cover; driver/passenger injury and qualifying third-party property are covered categories. Other-vehicle insurance may cover own-car loss under its conditions; this question does not guarantee every claim or amount.
